title: API Gateway
description: Envoy sidecar metrics (service_name=envoy): HTTP/listener traffic, upstream clusters, TLS/security, DNS/control plane, and server resources. Filter by Service and Environment.

panels.title: Downstream Connections Active
panels.description: Active downstream connections, by listener.

panels.title: Downstream Connections Rate
panels.description: New downstream connections per second, by listener.

panels.title: HTTP Requests Rate
panels.description: Downstream HTTP requests per second, by listener.

panels.title: Response Codes Rate
panels.description: Downstream HTTP responses per second, by status class.

panels.title: Request Duration (avg)
panels.description: Average downstream request duration, by listener.

panels.title: Downstream Connection Length (avg)
panels.description: Average downstream connection duration, by listener.

panels.title: Upstream Connections Active
panels.description: Active upstream connections, by cluster.

panels.title: Upstream Requests Active
panels.description: Active upstream requests, by cluster.

panels.title: Upstream Requests Rate
panels.description: Upstream requests per second, by cluster.

panels.title: Upstream Response Codes Rate
panels.description: Upstream responses per second, by cluster and status class.

panels.title: Upstream Request Latency (avg)
panels.description: Average upstream request duration, by cluster.

panels.title: Upstream Connect Time (avg)
panels.description: Average upstream connection establishment time, by cluster.

panels.title: Circuit Breakers Open
panels.description: Circuit breaker open state, by cluster.

panels.title: Upstream Pending Requests
panels.description: Requests queued waiting for a connection, by cluster.

panels.title: TLS Handshakes Rate
panels.description: Successful TLS handshakes per second, by listener.

panels.title: SSL Versions Rate
panels.description: TLS handshakes per second, by protocol version.

panels.title: SSL Ciphers Rate
panels.description: TLS handshakes per second, by cipher suite.

panels.title: Certificate Expiration
panels.description: Days remaining before the first certificate expires.

panels.title: TLS Inspector Bytes Processed
panels.description: Bytes per second processed by the TLS inspector.

panels.title: TLS Inspector ALPN Detection
panels.description: ALPN found vs. not found, per second.

panels.title: DNS Resolutions Rate
panels.description: DNS resolutions per second (c-ares).

panels.title: DNS Timeouts / Not Found Rate
panels.description: DNS resolution failures per second.

panels.title: DNS Pending Resolutions
panels.description: DNS resolutions currently in flight.

panels.title: SDS Update Attempts Rate
panels.description: Secret discovery service update attempts per second.

panels.title: SDS Update Duration (avg)
panels.description: Average secret discovery service update duration.

panels.title: Control Plane Connected State
panels.description: 1 if connected to the control plane (xDS), 0 otherwise.

panels.title: Control Plane Pending Requests
panels.description: Requests pending against the control plane.

panels.title: LDS Update Success / Failure Rate
panels.description: Listener discovery service update outcomes per second.

panels.title: Active Listeners
panels.description: Number of currently active listeners.

panels.title: Server Live
panels.description: 1 if the Envoy server is live and serving traffic.

panels.title: Server Uptime
panels.description: Envoy server uptime.

panels.title: Server Memory (Allocated / Heap)
panels.description: Envoy process memory usage.

panels.title: Server Connections (Total / Parent)
panels.description: Total and parent (hot restart) connections.

panels.title: Days Until First Cert Expiring
panels.description: Server-tracked certificate expiration window.

panels.title: Overload Actions Active
panels.description: Overload manager actions currently engaged.

panels.title: Overload Resource Pressure
panels.description: Overload manager resource pressure ratios (0-1).

panels.title: HTTP/2 Active Frames (Outbound)
panels.description: Outbound HTTP/2 frames currently queued.

panels.title: Filesystem Buffered Writes
panels.description: Bytes buffered waiting to be flushed to disk.

panels.title: Access Log Writes / Dropped Rate
panels.description: OpenTelemetry access log throughput per second.
